capability_negotiation.description: Initialize declaring elicitation+sampling, confirm the server's declared capabilities before relying on them, browse resources/prompts (no auth needed).

defensive_and_authorization.description: Missing required field, disallowed extra field, and an unauthenticated write attempt — the server must reject all three.

notifications_on_login.description: Authenticate as a dispatcher; the server pushes tools/list_changed and request_container_release appears with no reconnect.

clean_container_release.description: A clean container (no hazmat, no hold, active carrier) is released immediately — no elicitation needed.

hazmat_held_release_with_elicitation.description: A hazmat + customs-held container triggers elicitation/create mid-call; the dispatcher confirms, a Pending release order is filed, customs then clears the hold, and a supervisor approves the release.
hazmat_held_release_with_elicitation.approval_notes: Hazmat docs verified, hold cleared by customs.

sampling_risk_assessment.description: assess_container_risk asks the CLIENT's own model to reason over container facts + policy text via sampling/createMessage.

progress_manifest_reconciliation.description: reconcile_vessel_manifest walks every manifest line item for a vessel, reporting progress after each one instead of one blocking response.

memory_and_knowledge_integration.description: Memory & RAG Lab: short-term buffer + scratchpad, promote-or-drop routing, a real consolidation conflict, Self-RAG-verified memory recall, and all three retrieval architectures on real policy questions, wired into the live agent loop via agent/knowledge.py.
memory_and_knowledge_integration.rag_question_general: What is the purpose of the hazmat handling policy?
memory_and_knowledge_integration.rag_question_exact_id: What does Rule 3 of the hazmat policy say?
memory_and_knowledge_integration.rag_question_multi_part: If a container is hazmat and has an active customs hold, what's the full approval chain before release?
